_comment: Golden vectors for the SHARED email-match normalization (plan I5 [R2-7] + go-live D5 import recheck): trim -> Unicode NFC -> lowercase -> IDN domain to punycode ASCII. The FULL local part is kept (NO plus-address stripping); input with no usable local@domain split falls back to the trimmed/NFC/lowercased whole string. Implementations: pipeline common.normalize_email (Python, codecs idna) and app lib/email-match.ts normalizeEmailForMatch (Node, url.domainToASCII). Both MUST map every `input` to `expected` byte-for-byte - the D5 HMAC boundary only works if normalization is identical on both sides. Known engine divergence (IDNA2003 vs UTS46, e.g. eszett domains) is kept OUT of this corpus deliberately; extend only with vectors verified equal on both engines.
